scripts.demo: npm run build -w @asymmetry/shared && npm run demo -w @asymmetry/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w @asymmetry/server" "npm run dev -w @asymmetry/web --if-present"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @asymmetry/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @asymmetry/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number);const ok=(v[0]===22&&v[1]>=12)||v[0]===24||v[0]>=26;if(!ok){console.error('asymmetry requires Node ^22.12 or ^24 or >=26; got '+process.version);process.exit(1)}const m=(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').match(/npm\/(\d+)/);if(m&&Number(m[1])<10){console.error('asymmetry requires npm >=10; got npm/'+m[1]);process.exit(1)}"
